searches.title: Men's Vintage Tweed Sport Coats
searches.benchmark: Visual benchmark: the J. Press Light Olive Barleycorn Harris Tweed Sport Coat — muted, sophisticated, earthy brown/olive/taupe coloring with a traditional Ivy/English-country feel.
searches.criteria: Classic Ivy League / English-country tweed sport coat or blazer. Priority brands: J. Press, Brooks Brothers, Dunn & Co., Austin Reed, DAKS, Magee, Burberry/Burberrys, Aquascutum, Polo Ralph Lauren, O'Connell's, Southwick, Norman Hilton, Chipp, Andover Shop, Paul Stuart, and quality unbranded Harris Tweed. Harris Tweed preferred, also Donegal/Shetland. Muted brown, brown-grey, taupe, peat, lovat, light olive, olive-brown, oatmeal-brown; fine herringbone or barleycorn preferred, subtle nailhead/check okay; avoid orange/rust and loud plaids. Soft/natural shoulder, Ivy sack (3-roll-2) or classic 2/3-button — sport coat, not an overcoat. Sizes: priority 36S/36R/38S/38R, also 40S or others if measurements could be tailored to fit (shoulders ~17–18in, pit-to-pit ~19–21in, back length ~28–29.5in; sleeves alterable). Good wearable vintage condition or better, no significant moth damage/holes/stains/structural damage. Price: prioritize under $300, ideally under $200; an exceptional piece can run higher. Search eBay, Etsy, Grailed, Poshmark, Depop, Mercari, vintage menswear dealers and general web.
